Subject: Demo environment — urgent ask to keep live while PO clears

Hi Grace,

Quick note from procurement — we're still waiting on an internal approval loop for the PO. The legal review flagged one clause and finance has queued the payment until that's resolved. We expect this to clear next week (best estimate 05/24), but the demo timer is scheduled to expire in 3 days and the team will lose access to the environment and their integration tests.

Is Redwood able to provision a short interim buffer so our engineers can continue validating integrations? A short voucher or a 7-day extension would be ideal. I've attached the draft PO for reference.

Attachment: MediLoop_PO_draft_May16.pdf (application/pdf)

Appreciate any help — we don't want momentum to stall.

- Once approved, we'll apply the voucher and pause the demo expiry for 7 days — you should see immediate access.
